classification_rule.SELECTOR_CONSENSUS_RESOLVED: at least one predeclared comparator resolves; all resolved predeclared comparators agree on the same channel
classification_rule.SELECTOR_DEPENDENT: at least two admissible predeclared comparators resolve to different channels
classification_rule.SIGNATURE_INSUFFICIENT_UNRESOLVED: no declared cyclic stabilizer obstruction is proved but none of the predeclared exact comparators resolves uniquely
classification_rule.SYMMETRY_UNRESOLVED: an exact declared channel-label automorphism stabilizes the relevant full signature and moves every candidate label in its orbit, forbidding unique equivariant deterministic selection

length_firewall: ALIGNED_SEGMENT_CELL_COUNT=L and all six L equal at every positive decision; L never enters selector arithmetic
